salariesPage.title: Mushaharrada Shaqaalaha
salariesPage.subtitle: Dejiso oo maamul mushaharka bishii ee shaqaale kasta, maareeyaha, iyo darawalka.
salariesPage.empty: Lama helin shaqaale, maareeye, ama darawal.

toasts.paid: Waa la calaamadiyay in la bixiyay — waxaa lagu daray Maaliyadda sida kharash
toasts.unpaid: Bixinta waa la baabi'iyay — waxaa laga saaray Maaliyadda

attendancePage.title: Xaadirinta
attendancePage.subtitle: Calaamadi oo dib u eeg xaadirinta maalinlaha ah ee shaqaale kasta, maareeyaha, iyo darawalka.
attendancePage.empty: Lama helin shaqaale, maareeye, ama darawal.

faceEnroll.title: Diiwaangeli wajiga: {{name}}
faceEnroll.errorCamera: Kamaradda lama gali karin. Fadlan hubi ogolaanshaha kadibna isku day.
faceEnroll.errorNoFace: Wax wajiga ah lama arag — isku day marlaba iftiin wanaagsan.
faceEnroll.uploadHint: Isticmaal sawir cad, dhawaan qaaday, oo si toos ah wajiga u eegaya si xaadirinta loo hubiyo si sax ah.

faceEnrollmentPage.title: Diiwaangelinta Wajiga
faceEnrollmentPage.subtitle: Diiwaangeli wajiga shaqaalaha si ay uga xaadiri karaan kiosk-ga xaadirinta wajiga.
faceEnrollmentPage.empty: Wax shaqaale, maamule, ama darawal ah lama helin.

faceCheckInPage.title: Xaadirinta Wajiga
faceCheckInPage.subtitle: Fiiri kamaradda si aad u xaadirto ama uga baxdo.
faceCheckInPage.errorCamera: Kamaradda lama gali karin. Fadlan hubi ogolaanshaha kadibna isku day.
faceCheckInPage.notEnrolled: Wajigaaga wali lama diiwaangelin. Weydii maamule inuu ku diiwaangeliyo.
faceCheckInPage.methodNotAllowed: Akoonkaagu wuxuu ku xaddidan yahay xaadirinta gacanta. Isticmaal badhanka xaadirinta.

attendanceReminder.title: Ha ilaawin inaad xaadirto
attendanceReminder.body: Maanta wali ma xaadirin. Hadda xaadir si xaadirintaadu loo diiwaangeliyo.
attendanceReminder.faceOnlyBody: Maanta wali ma xaadirin. Akoonkaagu wuxuu u baahan yahay kiosk-ga Xaadirinta Wajiga.

myAttendancePage.title: Xaadirintayda
myAttendancePage.subtitle: Calaamadi gelitaankaaga marka aad timaaddo, iyo bixitaankaaga marka aad baxdo.
myAttendancePage.historyEmpty: Wali wax xaadirin ah lama diiwaangelin.
